# Reorder tasks and read, filter, and remove typed metadata.
exec tuck$exe init
exec tuck$exe add 'First draft' --state todo --json
json
stdout '"number": "001"'
exec tuck$exe add 'Second draft' --state todo --json
json
stdout '"number": "002"'

exec tuck$exe meta set 001 priority 3 --json
json
stdout '"priority": 3'
exec tuck$exe meta set 001 labels '["web", "images"]' --json
json
stdout '"labels":'
stdout '"images"'

exec tuck$exe meta get 001 priority --json
json
stdout '"key": "priority"'
stdout '"value": 3'

exec tuck$exe find draft --meta priority=3 --meta 'labels=["web","images"]' --json
json
stdout '"number": "001"'
! stdout '"number": "002"'

exec tuck$exe reorder 002 --first --json
json
stdout '"order": 1'
exec tuck$exe list todo --json
json
stdout '(?s)"title": "Second draft".*"title": "First draft"'

exec tuck$exe meta unset 001 priority --json
json
! stdout '"priority":'
exec tuck$exe meta get 001 --json
json
stdout '"labels":'
! stdout '"priority":'
exec tuck$exe check --json
json
stdout '"ok": true'
